notes: Contexto similarity v2 (question factory spec 4.10). Weights sum to 100, so a player scores 100 against himself. franchise_seasons: Jaccard of team-abbr:season sets (as v1). era: overlap of career year ranges (as v1). position: same 1, same family 0.5 (as v1). draft_class: 1 - |draft year difference| / span_years, an undrafted player's class is his first season. style: cosine of [ppg, rpg, apg, height_in] each divided by style.max, a missing value counts 0. fame: 1 - |fame_score difference| / span, clamped to [0, 1]. country: same country 1, same region 0.5, else or unknown 0; country_aliases folds spelling variants first. Anchor pairs in contexto-anchors.json must hold for every change (test_questions_similarity). Tuning (2026-10-16, against the shipped dataset): the brief's weights were franchise_seasons 30, era 15, position 10, draft_class 10, style 15, fame 10, country 10; at those Magic Johnson / Kareem Abdul-Jabbar ranked 91 and 51 (era-peer guards drafted around 1979 outscored a 10-season teammate) and 38 of 71 candidate near pairs held. franchise_seasons +5, position -4, draft_class -1 put Magic / Kareem at 15 and 12 and hold 46 near and 26 far pairs. gate: validate() refuses a v2 day whose top team_season_top (ranks 2..11) all share one team-season, or whose top famous_top (ranks 2..21) holds fewer than min_count players of min_band or better. Counting the famous over the top 10 instead let only 233 of the 501 KNOWN-or-better secrets pass on the shipped dataset; over the top 20 (ruling 2026-10-16), 426 of 501 secrets pass the gate on the 2026-10 dataset.
